name: Hoyocasero (Spain)
description: Square white flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Hoyocasero (a pine on green and roundels on blue).
history: The flag used by the municipality is described as a square flag entirely white with the arms of the municipality at the centre in the proportion 1:2 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 82 of 5 June 1987).
